TRANSACTION.capture: Full JSON native object before direct/batch serializer; all root/item/payment fields retained, including unknown observed fields.
extraRequirements: all historical tax and payment FX/change values
refund original reference and gateway disposition
unresolved: commercial VOID and CASH/multicurrency refund semantics

CASH_MOVEMENT.capture: Full native JSON; scope and historical currency proven separately.
extraRequirements: opening movement evidence, not fixedCashFund configuration
unresolved: native optional currency/terminal cannot be invented

COLLECTION.capture: Full Collection with allocations; Advance is same identity with bookingActivityId.
extraRequirements: received original/base, applied/unapplied base, rate, currency
document heads and historical booking linkage
unresolved: ERP receiver and durable application states

WALLET.capture: Full movement plus separate historical wallet context; preserve signed amount and referenceId literally.
extraRequirements: historical currency/customer and resolved technical link or UNKNOWN

Z_REPORT.capture: Entire original including every persisted annex/aliases/declarations and repeat metadata; no recalculation during import.
extraRequirements: original member selection, configuration, declaration, environment and series evidence

captureRules.timestamps: New capture converts valid Date only at declared PaymentEntry.timestamp to ISO UTC ms; string dates preserved. Other Date paths require declared rule or reject. Invalid/null not replaced by NOW.
captureRules.absent: Absent stays absent; explicit null and zero preserved. Unknown observed JSON retained with validation UNKNOWN. Undefined/function/nonfinite are not JSON: fail capture profile rather than silently erase.
captureRules.historical: Direct/batch originals stay immutable, never completed from current masters.
captureRules.number: No change to native money precision or rounding. Counters decimal strings. Raw numeric lexeme precision not reconstructable after parse.
captureRules.raw: Future ingress rejects duplicate JSON keys; not implemented.

blockRules.sourceVersions: Hashes of all calculation dependencies and selector version; no default current version
blockRules.paymentMethods: Ordered PaymentMethodDefinition[] excluding integrationConfig; exclusion explicit in this new profile, never applied retroactively to original. All other fields preserved.
blockRules.taxes: Complete ordered TaxDefinition[] and observed taxRate
blockRules.serviceTaxPolicies: Both config aliases and terminal effective policy if consulted; absent recorded explicitly
blockRules.terminalTaxDefaults: Effective operational.defaultTaxIds, explicit absence and resolver version
blockRules.closeOptions: Exact effective session cash-fund, denomination and report-section options by operator; include resolved options plus captured source
blockRules.resumeAnchor: Full accepted-provisionally J2 object or explicit PROVEN_FIRST evidence; never inferred null
blockRules.readCoverage: Inventory of configuration paths read by each selector/calculator; unexpected read blocks exactness. No dynamic instrumentation implemented.

configuration.printing: Separate versioned print-context snapshot of public company/receipt/assets/locale/printer layout and persisted annexes. Exact reproduction not certified until renderer dependencies inventoried.
